title: Chapter 50 — The Warm Path: Mining Your Existing Book
intro: The fastest accounts come from relationships you already have — the bridge call and referral engine.

sections.title: Mine Before You Prospect
sections.content:
Before cold calling builders you have never met, mine the relationships you already have. Your retail customers include homeowners who hired contractors, designers, and builders. Your existing trade accounts know other trade professionals.

The bridge call: 'Hi [customer name], I hope you are still loving the kitchen. Quick question — who was your contractor on that project? I would love to connect with them about our trade program.'

sections.title: The Referral Ask for Trade
sections.content:
Every delivered trade project is a referral opportunity. 'The project turned out great. Do you know any other builders or designers who might benefit from working with us? I would love an introduction.'

Every designer you work with knows builders. Every builder knows other builders. One introduction from a trusted source is worth 50 cold calls.
